meta.title: Audit C/C++ code for performance improvements
meta.body_summary: Add an AI-generated performance audit report (nntrainer_performance_audit_report.md) containing code review suggestions and estimated improvements for the nntrainer framework.

perf_labels.notes: Cursor generated a performance audit report with no code changes; maintainer labeled DO NOT MERGE and Generated Content, then closed.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 465 lines of added documentation in a single file, this is a small change by absolute volume. As a documentation-only PR with no code change, it was closed—not merged—because maintainers labeled it as generated content and DO NOT MERGE.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer added 'DO NOT MERGE' and 'Generated Content' labels and closed the PR without merging; no human review comments in dataset. Only a bot format check (APPROVED).
review_details.performance_claim: The audit report claims to identify bottlenecks and proposes code changes that could improve latency 3-5x, throughput 200-400%, and reduce memory consumption 30-50%.
review_details.rejection_signals: Maintainer labeled 'DO NOT MERGE' and 'Generated Content' then closed; bot cpp-linter APPROVED without substantive review.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Cursor produced a comprehensive markdown audit report, but the PR was closed as generated content without code changes; this illustrates a process boundary where maintainers expect actionable code, not AI-generated analysis documents.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No code changes to reproduce; performance claims are narrative.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed with 'DO NOT MERGE' label; no further action taken.

core_change_summary.description: Added nntrainer_performance_audit_report.md, a 465-line audit report with performance improvement suggestions for tensor operations, memory management, convolution, network execution, and matrix operations.
change_trajectory: Cursor agent committed the audit report and PR opened.
Maintainer labeled 'DO NOT MERGE' and 'Generated Content', then closed the PR without merge.

review_signals.summary: Cpp-linter reported no formatting concerns and approved.

collaboration_trajectory: Cursor opened PR with performance audit report.
Maintainer added 'DO NOT MERGE' and 'Generated Content' labels.
Maintainer closed PR without merge ~2.45 hours after creation.
